title: On the Uniqueness of a Nonlinear Discrete Calderón Problem
summary: The discrete Calderón problem aims at recovering the conductivity on the edges of a graph from boundary measurements, encoded by the discrete Dirichlet-to-Neumann (DtN) map. The problem has been intensively studied in the linear case on square lattices since the seminal works of Curtis and Morrow. In this work, we investigate a nonlinear analogue of the discrete Calderón problem for a semilinear second-order elliptic equation on square lattices.
